key_insight: Matching rooftop solar generation with climate-driven demand and EV battery storage can supply up to 84% of annual building and mobility electricity needs.
engineering_relevance: Urban PV-EV planning should prioritize hourly supply-demand alignment and seasonal variability, rather than solar capacity factor alone.
method: Simulate rooftop PV coupled with EV batteries across 5,000 global grid cells.
Use hourly meteorology and climate-induced electricity demand.
Assess self-sufficiency and compare potential with capacity-factor-based screening.
evidence_signal: The simulations indicate that capacity-factor-only screening undervalues PV-EV potential in 21.9% of the world's 1,000 most populous cities.
watch_item: Real-world performance will depend on EV availability for storage and charging coordination; the reported potential is simulation-based.
paper_title: Climate-Driven Supply-Demand Matching Reshapes Global SolarEV Decarbonization Potential
